scope: Page-budget scenarios for direct Clinton-Yeltsin memcons/telcons in the FRUS 1993-2000, Volume XVIII compiler packet.
estimateMethod: Pending hard-gap pages are estimated with the median actual conversation pages for counted contacts of the same type. They are not counted pages.

scenarios.label: Tier 1 likely core
scenarios.description: Smallest high-confidence first pass: documents with the highest selection score and issue density.

scenarios.label: Tier 1-2 strong core
scenarios.description: Likely core plus strong candidates; useful as a practical first draft of the Clinton-Yeltsin document spine.

scenarios.label: Heavy annotation review set
scenarios.description: All counted documents likely to require substantial annotation, regardless of selection tier.

scenarios.label: Tier 1-3 broad draft
scenarios.description: Broad working draft for thematic balancing before later trimming.

scenarios.label: All counted documents
scenarios.description: The full current reading packet: every page-counted Clinton-Yeltsin memcon/telcon.

scenarios.label: Hard source gaps only
scenarios.description: The six uncounted contacts. Page totals here are estimates only, based on median pages of counted contacts of the same type.
